hold_text: This PR adds research/queue/RQ-20260927-004.yaml and research/queue/blocked/RQ-20260927-{005,006,007,008}.yaml as NEW files -- pre-registered decision rules -- which STAMP_ONLY_SURFACE and TIER1_SURFACE both correctly refuse to vouch for (identical precedent to PR #13081's w6-exit-head.json: 'registering a decision rule is exactly the act R5/E57's own comment says must hold for a human'). Every other changed path (scripts/backtest_trend.py, scripts/backtest_pullback.py, scripts/research/regime_weight.py, scripts/ops/m15_ws_c_soft_weight_kfold.sh, tests/test_regime_weight.py, docs/claude/strategy-refinement-queue.json) is inside TIER1_SURFACE and would self-land cleanly on its own. This is Tier-1 research work -- no config/, src/, or live order-path file is touched, no live gate or roster is changed -- held only because the guard correctly cannot certify a brand-new decision-rule file as a stamp.
why: Operator directive 2026-09-27 (docs/plans/review-pack-2026-09-27.md D6): SRQ-20260618-001/-002's soft-regime-weight refinement sat un-worked 6+ weeks after the hard-ADX-gate hypothesis was refuted 2026-08-11; dispatch a backtesting-skill lane rather than kill the row. (1) Adds the shared soft regime-weight lever (scripts/research/regime_weight.py: continuous ADX-ramp R-scaling, no per-cell tuning -- the exact degree of freedom that made the 2026-06-18 hard-gate holdout fail) and wires it into scripts/backtest_trend.py/backtest_pullback.py as new optional CLI flags, byte-identical when unset. (2) Pre-registers and dispatches RQ-20260927-004 (research/queue/, run.workflow: trainer-vm-diag.yml) -- the decision rule was written before scripts/ops/m15_ws_c_soft_weight_kfold.sh runs; the trainer-vm-diag-request issue dispatching it is filed separately from this PR since the guard only reads committed files. (3) Registers four further soft-weight research lines named in the operator's direction (vol-percentile input, ML regime-probability input, portfolio-vs-per-leg weighting, transition lag) as research/queue/blocked/RQ-20260927-{005,006,007,008}.yaml -- each pre-registered with a full decision rule but genuinely blocked on harness capability that does not exist yet, per research/queue/README.md's blocked/ convention. (4) Appends an append-only `dispatched_2026_09_27` field to SRQ-20260618-001/-002 in docs/claude/strategy-refinement-queue.json pointing at the new units -- does not touch or supersede the existing hard-gate refutation, which stands unchanged. No config/, src/, or live-path file is touched; no live gate, roster or Tier-3 decision is made on this branch.
